principle: Existing exact role/name strings are an automation hook, not automatically a business requirement. Each item was decided and recorded before any new material was built (2026-10-19).
unchanged_global_requirements: Every action used by a scenario is visible/discoverable by a normal user and operable by mouse and keyboard.
Interactive controls expose an appropriate role and a meaningful accessible name (icon buttons included).
Fields have an associated accessible name (label, aria-label or placeholder).
Each business object (note, page, book) is visibly identified by its business title, and its actions/fields are scoped to it.
Page/book titles on detail views are headings.

relaxations.source_role_or_name_purpose: Fixed English labels such as Take a note, Close, Title, Content, Search, Suggested filters, Edit, Save Page, Page title, Page list let the current tests locate controls.
relaxations.relaxed_constraint: A fixed label may be replaced by another clear English name for the same operation or field. Examples: 'Close' -> 'Done' / 'Close editor' / an x icon named 'Close note'; 'Take a note' -> 'New note' / 'Create note'; 'Save Page' -> 'Save' / 'Publish page'; 'Page title' -> 'Title'.
still_invalid_examples: a name that no longer conveys the operation (e.g. 'OK' for creating a note with no context)
replacing autosave-on-close by a 'Save' button that must be clicked

relaxations.source_role_or_name_purpose: role=textbox/searchbox/button/checkbox/dialog is how the tests find and operate controls.
relaxations.relaxed_constraint: When the semantics match, a native input/textarea, a contenteditable rich-text editor, a component-library input, a menu option, a listbox option, a toggle chip or a switch may be used, each with its normal operation. The editor surface may be a dialog, an inline expanding card, or a drawer.
retained_business_obligations: the value can be read back by a user
the result is reached through the specified interaction
still_invalid_examples: a clickable div with no role/keyboard access
a field that cannot be typed into by keyboard

relaxations.source_role_or_name_purpose: Each note is region '{title}', each page entry is button/link '{title}' inside region 'Page list'; these are test anchors.
relaxations.relaxed_constraint: Notes and page lists may be organised as cards, list items, table rows or plain sections without a test-only region/listitem accessible name.
retained_business_obligations: visible unique business identifier per object
object's actions and fields distinguishable from other objects
the page list is identifiable as the book's pages (e.g. a heading 'Pages')
still_invalid_examples: two notes merged in one container with no visible boundary
page entries without a visible title

relaxations.source_role_or_name_purpose: Body text exactness, 'Highlight st' region and 'Suggested filters' region let tests read results.
relaxations.relaxed_constraint:
Body line breaks may be rendered as pre-wrap text,
or separate block elements. The highlight element/markup is free (mark, span, strong). The suggested-filters panel may be any container that is identifiable by a visible heading or an accessible name with that meaning.
retained_business_obligations: both lines visible on distinct lines (A-K22-1)
the highlight is real and visible per V-HL
still_invalid_examples: highlight that only exists as an aria name with no visual difference
highlight of a whole word instead of the match

implementer_input: Implementers receive the S1 meaning+constraints (this manifest's relaxed_constraint text plus the requirements), NOT an alias table from the method developer.
